description: Source code for PSA attestation functions in Zephyr OS, including functions to get public key, generate initial attestation token, and perform attestation test with logging and hex dump.

methods.name: att_get_pub_key
methods.description: Retrieves the public key for attestation (currently a placeholder).

methods.name: att_get_iat
methods.description: Generates an initial attestation token based on challenge data.

methods.name: att_test
methods.description: Performs an attestation test, requesting IAT, logging, and dumping hex data.
